tools.name: fetch_ai_guide
tools.description:
Fetch an official Duck Framework AI guide.
Use this after get_ai_guides() to retrieve the full guide content for
AI-assisted Duck Framework development.
Always read the relevant guide before generating code instead of relying
on memory.

tools.name: get_ai_guides
tools.description:
List available Duck Framework AI guides.
Use this to discover available guides before fetching one with
fetch_ai_guide().
Returns guide identifiers and their descriptions.

tools.name: get_blueprint_locations
tools.description:
Explain where Duck Framework blueprints can be located.
Describes the supported blueprint layouts and when each organization
approach is appropriate.

tools.name: get_blueprint_structure
tools.description:
Return the standard internal structure of a Duck Framework blueprint.
Use this before generating a new blueprint or adding files to an existing
one to understand where components, pages, templates, automations, and
views belong.

tools.name: get_component_api
tools.description:
Look up a built-in Duck Framework component API.
Returns the confirmed import path, container type, and supported keyword
arguments for a component without requiring the full HTML components guide
to be loaded.
Use this before using any component that has not already been confirmed.
Returns close-na

tools.name: get_project_structure
tools.description:
Return the standard Duck Framework project directory structure.
Use this before creating or modifying projects to understand where files
and directories belong.

tools.name: lint_component_code
tools.description:
Check Duck Framework component or page code for common mistakes.
Detects known patterns such as incorrect component imports, invalid page
imports, incorrect Heading usage, leading-underscore method names, and
separator comments.
This is a pattern check for known issues, not a complete correctness
va

tools.name: list_doc_categories
tools.description:
List all Duck Framework documentation categories and their pages.
Use this when browsing available documentation without a specific
search query.

tools.name: plan_feature
tools.description:
Analyze a Duck Framework feature request and create an implementation plan.
Returns relevant documentation to read and a suggested order of operations
before writing code. Use this before implementing non-trivial Duck
Framework features.

tools.name: reindex_docs
tools.description:
Rebuild the Duck Framework documentation index.
Crawls the live documentation sitemap for a given version and merges
the result in: curated tags/summary/category are preserved, new pages
are added, and pages no longer in the sitemap are removed.
Requires the admin scope.

tools.name: scaffold_blueprint
tools.description:
Scaffold a new Duck Framework blueprint.
Generates a blueprint structure containing blueprint.py, views.py, and
optional UI, template, and static directories following the documented
Duck blueprint conventions.
Returns generated file contents and the settings configuration needed to
register the blu

tools.name: scaffold_project
tools.description:
Scaffold a new Duck Framework project.
Returns the required CLI commands and generated file contents for
supported features with confirmed APIs. Unsupported features return
documentation guidance instead of generated code to avoid guessing
framework APIs.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description:
Fuzzy-search the Duck Framework documentation.
Use this whenever the correct documentation page for a feature is
unknown. Returns ranked matches containing title, URL, category,
summary, and relevance score.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_component_api" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Look up a built-in Duck Framework component API. Returns the confirmed import path, container type, and supported keyword arguments for a component without requ…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
